description: Fixed provenance for the frozen baseline app shell used by parity tests. scripts/capture-baseline.mjs materializes these exact bytes into the ignored .baseline/ directory and fails if the current Git blob no longer matches htmlBlob below.

storageState.note: Every scenario boots from a fresh browser context with no sessionStorage/localStorage keys set (no skey-proto-state, no skey-proto-ui), so Prototype Controls restoration always starts from its documented defaults.
